source_refs.note: 2- Cloning of Recombinant Vector: a main subheading of 20.2.2 Steps of Recombinant DNA Technology, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 158-159.

blocks.text: Recombinant DNA (vector) aur expression system (aam taur par bacteria) aik hi medium mein incubate kiye jate hain. Kuch bacterial cells recombinant DNA ko andar le lete hain. Phir yeh bacteria taqseem ho kar bacterial clones (aik jaise bacteria ke groups) banate hain, jin mein gene of interest ki bilkul aik jaisi copies, yaani clones, bhi hoti hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke medium mein rakhe gaye sab bacteria clones banate hain jin mein gene ki copies hoti hain. Sab bacteria recombinant DNA nahin lete: sirf thore se bacteria lete hain, aur kuch aisa plasmid le lete hain jis mein gene nahin. Jo bacterium gene wala DNA leta hai woh taqseem ho kar clone banata hai; isi liye agla qadam screening (chhaant) hai.
